component.name: ProbeView
component.script:
sub init() m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onViewFocus") end sub
' Builds the target from a field observer: CreateObject runs init() before any field is set. sub onKind() col = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") col.id = "col" if m.top.kind = "Keyboard" then target = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DynamicCustomKeyboard") else target = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") target.focusable = true end if target.id = "target" m.target = target m.top.target = target target.observeFieldScoped("focusedChild", "onTargetFocus") col.appendChild(target) m.top.appendChild(col) ' The view is still detached here, as in a component's init(). if m.top.initFocus then target.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onViewFocus() print "PROBE| onViewFocus hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr() if m.top.forward and m.top.hasFocus() then m.target.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onTargetFocus() print "PROBE| onTargetFocus hasFocus=" + m.target.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.target.isInFocusChain().toStr() end sub
